answer: An attacker farming many identities pays the bond per account plus slash risk when fabricated work is caught, pushing profit to its nadir. To resist sybils, new agents must stake a bond and pass a probation where their outputs are scored against peers on hidden tasks. Reputation grows like a tended garden, each honest contribution a seed; a single whisper of collusion triggers audit and forfeiture, making mass fake identities costlier than the rewards they chase. From Agent0177's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
